evidence: app/src/pages/ability.ts:1-30 — the ability page is a self-contained module; delete it wholesale
app/src/main.ts:17 — one route line + one import to drop
app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:79,123-140 — abilitiesSection must also be edited because it links to /abilities/
app/server.mjs:31 — the route table is duplicated in the server, so a second edit is required to keep them in sync
app/src/api.ts:59-66 — Ability interface would be left as dead types unless removed
removability.rationale: Removing a feature is a handful of small, scattered edits rather than a directory delete plus a nav link; the server-side duplicate route list is the main trap.

evidence: app/src/components.ts:18-33 — every Pokémon card in the app renders via pokemonCard, so a sprite fix lands here once
app/src/api.ts:160 — spriteUrl is the single source of the sprite URL pattern
app/src/api.ts:210-225 — the Pokémon→species / alternate-form mapping is centralized in toSpeciesCards, not repeated per list
app/src/pages/move.ts:11-13 — effect-fallback rule (short_effect || flavor || —) duplicated with app/src/pages/ability.ts:8-10
app/src/pages/home.ts:36-48 — 'default Pokémon's types' derived here by scanning type payloads, separately from app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:50 using pokemon.types
changeability.rationale: The two highest-risk domains (sprites, species mapping) are single-point fixes that cover every page; only the small effect-text rule and the types derivation exist twice.

evidence: app/src/pages/*.ts:1-3 — pages depend only on api.ts exports and shared components, never on each other
app/src/api.ts:10,108-121 — data fetching, base URL and cache are one module with a narrow get() seam
app/src/dom.ts:1-33 — h/section keep DOM construction behind a tiny helper instead of pages touching document APIs ad hoc
app/server.mjs:31 vs app/src/main.ts:13-21 — route knowledge duplicated between server and client
app/src/nav.ts:1-9 vs app/src/main.ts:71 — history manipulation split across two modules with overlapping jobs
coupling.rationale: Layering is clean and seams are narrow for a framework-free app; the duplicated route table and the split URL helpers are the only tangles.

evidence: app/src/api.ts:210-225 — toSpeciesCards absorbs the real variation (type/move/ability Pokémon refs → species cards) once, with a generic item type
app/src/components.ts:18-33 — pokemonCard's optional `extra` slot handles per-page differences (type badges, 'Hidden ability') without boolean flags
app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:146-160 — moves tables are column-descriptor driven, so a new column is one entry
app/src/pages/move.ts:16 — `fact` dl helper is local to the move page; an Items page would copy it
app/src/pages/move.ts:11-13 — effect fallback already copy-pasted into ability.ts, foreshadowing a third copy for items
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track the app's genuine variation points and avoid flag-parameter creep; a couple of small presentational helpers (fact dl, effect text) missed extraction and are now duplicated.

findings.issue: The route table is duplicated as a second set of regexes alongside app/src/main.ts:13-21; adding or removing a page requires editing both or the server serves the wrong status
findings.suggestion: Share one source of truth — e.g. export the path patterns from a module both the server and the client import, or fall back to 200 for any non-asset path and let the client render Not found

findings.issue: The display rule 'short_effect, else latest English flavor text, else —' (plus whitespace collapsing) is copy-pasted in app/src/pages/ability.ts:8-10 and would be copied a third time for any new resource page
findings.suggestion: Extract an effectText(effectEntries, flavorEntries) helper next to latestFlavorText in api.ts and use it from both pages

findings.issue: URL/history handling is split between updateUrl (nav.ts) and navigate/render (main.ts:71-86), with no comment-level guidance on when to use which
findings.suggestion: Move updateUrl into main.ts (or a single router module) so all history mutation lives in one place

findings.issue: The `fact` description-list helper is local to the move page; a similarly-shaped Items page would duplicate it
findings.suggestion: Promote a factsList(...) helper to components.ts alongside cardList/countText

findings.issue: The concept 'a species' default Pokémon's types' is derived twice: here by scanning all type payloads into an id→types map, and in pokemon.ts:44-53 from pokemon.types
findings.suggestion: Add a comment noting why home derives it differently (can't fetch 1025 Pokémon), or move the id→types map builder into api.ts as a named aggregate so both derivations point at one documented concept

findings.issue: Event-handler attributes aren't typed as listeners, forcing `as EventListener` casts at app/src/components.ts:16, app/src/pages/home.ts:111 and app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:230, and a typo like `oncick` would silently become an attribute
findings.suggestion: Type the on* keys in Attrs (e.g. `on${string}` → EventListener) so handlers are checked and casts disappear

findings.issue: section() generates heading IDs from a module-global counter, so landmark wiring is implicit and only #moves is explicitly named (app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:323)
findings.suggestion: Accept an optional id/name argument and derive the heading id from it (`${id}-heading`), keeping the aria-labelledby relationship greppable

summary: This is a well-layered vanilla-TS SPA where the two hardest cross-cutting concerns — sprite URLs and Pokémon-vs-species mapping — are centralized so a fix lands once and covers every list. The main editability costs are a route table duplicated between client and server, a couple of small presentational rules already copy-pasted between the move and ability pages, and URL helpers split across two modules. Nothing would make me hesitate to hand this to another engineer.
